br_quality.note: Lane A measures exact best responses; a reached target is a measured value, not a sampled estimate.

diagnostics.methods_note: Methods produced different measurements; the summary is a comparison. `identical_method_groups` lists methods that agreed on every seed, which is expected when two presets share an update rule on a spot without chance nodes.
diagnostics.seeds_note: No seed group reported one measurement across a sampled range; an enumerated range is seed-independent and is not flagged.

environment.note: Wall clocks and peak RSS are machine-specific evidence, not a CI speed gate.

methods.quality_definition: exploitability_mbb_per_game: exploitability (half the raw NashConv) in mbb per hand of the declared big blind, from the same exact best-response evaluator for every method

unsupported.reason: PCFR+ is not implemented in the lane A solver, so its update and averaging semantics cannot be matched to the AAAI 2026 schedules. It is not a parameter-only change and stays unsupported.

Neural predictive CFR is not implemented in this lane. Its reported match reward is not a PLO exploitability certificate, and its sampling, replay-buffer and training costs are not comparable with a tabular CFR solve.
Imported commercial-solver strategies are excluded: class mapping, range/board/tree equivalence and quantized action probabilities have not been validated, so they are not a reproduced benchmark.
